                        prob2 = (prob2 * (1 + MOD - p[j][k + 3])) % MOD;

            for (int ot = 0; ot < 20; ot++) {

                        int loc = val * 3 + j;

                        break;
                    }

                do {

                    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
                        int val = permsB.get(ot)[ord[j]];

    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr) {
        int i = arr.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && arr[i] >= arr[i+1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;

        int j = arr.length - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) j--;

        int temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;

        int k = arr.length - 1;

            arr[k] = temp;
            i++;
            k--;
        }
        return true;
